newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA governor appear before committee Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA governor appear before committee Sept 12.

text.p: Incoming Reserve Bank of Australia governor Ian Macfarlane and outgoing governor Bernie Fraser will attend a parliamentary committee hearing on the central bank's annual report, an RBA spokesman said on Tuesday.

The annual hearing of the Financial Institutions and Public Administration Committee will be held in Canberra on September 12. Although formerly focussed on the annual report these appearances usually cover broader economic issues.
